title: Authoroad companion strip: visual kit for auth, key rotation, streaming and tool-calling flows
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a cohesive, reusable illustration and screenshot kit to support the new API/SDK Quickstart docs that cover: 1) API auth handoff (API keys and token exchange), 2) short-lived key rotation UX, 3) streaming responses and prefix/KV cache visualizations, and 4) tool-calling lifecycle (declaration, invocation, result rendering). Deliverables should include annotated screenshots, a set of 8 vector illustrations (light + dark variants), compact micro-animations for the web quickstart, annotated code snippet overlays, and export-ready assets for product docs and marketing. The kit must include accessibility guidance (alt text, color-contrast compliant palettes) and responsive variants for mobile docs. Goal: reduce developer confusion at first-run, lower support tickets for auth mistakes, and provide engineering with pixel-perfect assets for SDK repos.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Eight vector illustrations completed and reviewed in Figma (light/dark)
2) Three annotated product screenshots (browser key creation, streaming console, tool-call playground) exported at required sizes
3) Micro-animation prototypes (Lottie or GIF) for streaming progress and tool-call handshake
4) Asset naming and export spec documented in Confluence with usage examples and code snippet overlays
5) Accessibility checklist completed and signed off by Accessibility lead
6) Final files uploaded to Drive and linked in PR for docs team
notes: Prefer minimal iconography to avoid visual noise; use a distinct accent color for key-related UI states to improve scannability. Coordinate with ENG-2801 for updated key rotation API UX before finalizing the rotation sequence art.
